_README: Lab-only endpoint photometry for the pilot displays. Measured with a Minolta spot photometer, screen normal, central patch, same room lighting as the sessions, >=15 min warm-up. Fill L_black_cd_m2 (255=0 pixel value) and L_white_cd_m2 (255 pixel value) per display. Units: cd/m^2. This characterises the lab Mac-vs-Dell comparison only; online participants run on uncalibrated consumer displays and are NOT covered by this file. The pixel values are the stimulus endpoints: dots = #ffffff (white), background = #000000 (black).

Dell-2209WA.note: External secondary LCD used for translation + rotation (and the Monday spiral/translation replicate).

Mac-Retina-builtin.note: Built-in MacBook Retina panel used for the Saturday spiral run.
